name: sa-compliance-embeddings-v1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. MultipleNegativesRankingLoss fine-tune of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (33M, 384-dim) for POPIA regulatory retrieval: given a compliance scenario, return the right section text out of 114 POPIA sections. Identical tensor set to the base. 308 (anchor, positive) pairs, 6 epochs, batch 16, lr 2e-5, ~45 s on a GTX 1650. Eval is 128 entailment/contradiction scenarios held out from training, and the card prints the model-index YAML alongside the markdown table (0.4766 / 0.6563 there vs 0.477 / 0.656 rounded in the table). Read the ceiling: a Recall@1 that nearly doubles on a 114-document corpus is mostly domain-vocabulary effect - the base has no exposure to POPIA's section structure at all - so expect the gap to narrow on an open web-scale index. Card flags English-only and POPIA-only scope. Apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-30. Confidence 0.45.
